## CEO overview

- **What is changing:** Idle Codex secondmates resume queued work after finishing a turn, and healthy workers get enough time to finish longer tasks without false stall alerts.
- **Why it matters:** A secondmate could stop monitoring its own queue at turn end, leaving work waiting until someone prompted it again.
- **Customer or business impact:** Delegated work progresses with less manual intervention, and the captain receives fewer false alarms while workers are busy.
- **Risk and rollout:** Watcher startup and recovery are sensitive to timing and worker state.
  Deliver through the authorized second push-freeze exception and the existing no-mistakes pipeline; retain alerts for stale watchers, startup failures, and missing away-mode supervision.

## What changed technically

- Codex secondmate Stop hooks arm home-owned monitoring, surface queued wakes, and request bounded recovery after startup failures.
  Generated launches let the shared supervision classifier account for the home's current away-mode state.
- Backend state suppresses busy-turn stall paging for non-Grok/non-Pi mates with fresh beacons.
  Idle mates use a 600-second cadence plus grace; the explicit `FM_SECONDMATE_WAKE_STALL_SECS` override, Grok/Pi cadence and claims, and stale-beacon handling retain precedence.
- Optional home-local `config/watch.env` supplies validated non-executable defaults without replacing explicit environment values or repurposing generated `config/x-mode.env`.
  Operator setup and precedence are documented in `docs/configuration.md`.
- The existing generated-launch regression now checks healthy mid-turn silence, stale-beacon warnings, recovery, and Codex away-mode warnings instead of requiring the false alarm this change removes.
  The concurrent config-push regression holds its first delivery until the second push reaches the shared home, replacing fixed sleeps with bounded readiness checks.

- **Checks passed:** The prior Test phase passed focused wake-queue and generated-launch integration fixtures covering Stop rearming, queued home wakes, busy suppression, threshold overrides, and safe configuration precedence.
  The preceding CI repair passed all 49 secondmate harness tests after fixing an obsolete Codex supervision assertion and concurrent-push timing flake.
  This communication repair passes `bash tests/pr-communication.test.sh` and both GitHub Actions communication entrypoints against this narrative composed with the captured live Pipeline section.
- **Checks not run:** Hosted communication checks have not run against this replacement narrative; the live description still uses the rejected Intent, What Changed, Risk Assessment, and Testing headings.
  No live vendor-agent or multi-hour fleet soak was performed in this phase.
- **Evidence and limitations:** Integration fixtures execute Firstmate scripts with simulated backend endpoints and named local processes, so they prove orchestration behavior rather than vendor-agent interpretation.
  Captured [wake behavior](https://github.com/bingb0t5/firstmate/blob/3dc0e927af3b42598c773a37bb8bdaa21259098a/.no-mistakes/evidence/fm/fm-secondmate-wake-cadence-r1/wake-behavior.txt) and [generated-launch behavior](https://github.com/bingb0t5/firstmate/blob/3dc0e927af3b42598c773a37bb8bdaa21259098a/.no-mistakes/evidence/fm/fm-secondmate-wake-cadence-r1/launch-behavior.txt) remain available.
  Both communication entrypoints reproduce the failure against the live description at head `68d0e5a89d6341209478e1ae62bd2080b6608d16` and pass when only the narrative is replaced, retaining the Pipeline payload.
  The live description still lacks the required sections after two committed narrative repairs, confirming that another source commit alone cannot resolve this check.
  Publication remains required: the outer executor must compose this narrative with the latest machine-owned `## Pipeline` section using `bin/fm-pr-body-compose.sh`, publish that composed PR description after its final narrative rewrite, and verify the resulting hosted checks.

## Module-boundary decision

Current module retained: Stop handling, shared supervision classification, parent stall detection, and configuration loading remain with their existing script owners.
The optional watch settings use one shared loader so watcher and arm entrypoints apply the same validation and precedence.

## Decision needed

No decision required.
